detailed_description: Midjourney Prompt Generator builds one complete Midjourney prompt from a subject, art style, composition, lighting, atmosphere, version, aspect ratio, quality, and stylize value. The real component includes quick presets such as cinematic portrait, dream landscape, concept art, neon city, and nature photo, then outputs copy-ready text with --v, --ar, --q, and --s parameters. It does not generate images, call Midjourney, inspect prompts, or guarantee a particular visual result.
usage_steps: Choose the style, composition, lighting, and atmosphere.
Set the Midjourney version, aspect ratio, quality, and stylize values.
Use a preset if you want to fill the form quickly.
Generate and copy the prompt, then refine it in your own image workflow.
usage_examples: Create a cinematic portrait prompt with --ar 2:3 and a moody lighting preset.
Build a widescreen concept-art prompt for a futuristic scene.
Compare square, vertical, and widescreen parameter choices before testing.

faqs.question: Is the Midjourney Prompt Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does this create images?
faqs.answer: No. It creates text prompt variants only. Use the copied prompt in the image tool or creative workflow you choose.

faqs.question: Which Midjourney parameters are included?
faqs.answer: The generated prompt includes version, aspect ratio, quality, and stylize parameters using --v, --ar, --q, and --s syntax.

faqs.question: Does it use live Midjourney model data?
faqs.answer: No. It uses local template logic and form selections. Adjust the prompt after testing it in your own Midjourney workflow.
